title: Setting
description: A first-class LARP setting: a world or campaign that organises characters, events, and mechanics. Game entities can optionally be scoped to a setting; entities without a setting are shared across all settings. Finished campaigns are archived rather than deleted.

name.description: The name of the setting / campaign.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the setting. Archived settings are hidden from the active-setting switcher but their data stays readable.
